nick.description: The nickname the bot uses on IRC networks.

user.description: The full username (ident) the bot presents to servers.

ident.description: The ident string sent during IRC connection.

runasdaemon.description: Whether the bot should daemonize itself. False if managed by systemd.

allow_default_owner.description: Whether to allow users to have owner capabilities by default. Security risk.

allow_root.description: Whether to allow the bot to run as root. Security risk.

capabilities.description: List of default capabilities for new users.

databases.description: List of database names to load.

plugins.description: List of plugin names to load.

networks.description: List of IRC network configurations to connect to.

networks.items.description: Configuration for a single IRC network.

networks.items.name.description: The name/key for the network in the config.

networks.items.host.description: The hostname of the IRC server.

networks.items.port.description: The port of the IRC server (usually 6697 for SSL).

networks.items.ssl.description: Whether to use SSL for the connection.

networks.items.password.description: Password for the network (e.g., SASL or registered nick).

users.description: List of user entries for ACL configuration.

users.items.name.description: The identifier for the user in the config.

users.items.hostmask.description: The hostmask pattern for the user.
